details: This package is a reverse-engineered Claude Code CLI fork that, on first launch, derives a stable host identifier from the SMBIOS product UUID (`wmic csproduct get uuid`), falling back to /etc/hostid and NIC MAC addresses, and POSTs it to hxxps://ledger[.]zanii[.]agency/v1/account/signup to auto-register an organisation named `zaniicode-<fingerprint>`. It then mints a `zk_live_` ingest key via /v1/account/keys and persists it to ~/.zaniicode/zanii-account.json with mode 0600. Proof reporting is on by default (disabled only with ZANII_PROOF=0): every tool call the agent performs is POSTed to hxxps://ledger[.]zanii[.]agency/v1/receipts, carrying the tool name in cleartext as the receipt target (`cli.tool.<toolName>`), a salted SHA-256 of the tool payload, the host-derived agent DID, and a Merkle chain head refreshed hourly by a background interval. Memory writes are reported the same way. Separately, scripts/postinstall.cjs (also exposed as `bun run setup:ripgrep`) downloads a ripgrep release archive from hxxps://github[.]com/microsoft/ripgrep-prebuilt/releases/download/v15.0.1/, falling back to the hxxps://ghproxy[.]net/ mirror, spawning curl, powershell.exe (Invoke-WebRequest with -ExecutionPolicy Bypass) or tar to fetch and unpack it into dist/vendor/ripgrep/; the package also ships a bundled Windows ripgrep PE executable at dist/vendor/ripgrep/x64-win32/rg.exe. Additional third-party endpoints present in the code include hxxps://tavily[.]claude-code-best[.]win/search (default web-search backend) and hxxps://app[.]corridor[.]dev/api/mcp (documented MCP example). This package is an unauthorised redistribution of Anthropic's Claude Code CLI, published under a look-alike name and shipping two command-line entry points (ccz, ccz-bun) that execute bundled JavaScript from dist/. The bundle is built from Anthropic-internal sources: it contains internal workspace packages (@ant/*, @anthropic-ai/*), the internal host artifactory[.]infra[.]ant[.]dev, and a 5.4 MB Windows executable at dist/vendor/ripgrep/x64-win32/rg.exe. On use it downloads and executes a second binary from hxxps://github[.]com/microsoft/ripgrep-prebuilt/releases/download/v15[.]0[.]1/ripgrep-v15[.]0[.]1-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl[.]tar[.]gz. dist/chunk-wg593rha.js reads the user's ~/.npmrc, extracts the //artifactory[.]infra[.]ant[.]dev/artifactory/api/npm/npm-all/:_authToken credential from it, and sends it as an Authorization: Bearer header to hxxps://artifactory[.]infra[.]ant[.]dev/artifactory/armorcode-claude-code-internal/claude-vscode-releases/stable. Web search and web fetch requests are relayed to hxxps://tavily[.]claude-code-best[.]win/search and hxxps://tavily[.]claude-code-best[.]win/extract, from files that also read ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY. The bundle also includes Google and AWS credential-provider code that queries instance metadata endpoints (169[.]254[.]169[.]254, metadata.google.internal, fd00:ec2::254) and copies the full process environment into spawned child processes (`env: {...process.env,... }`).
